root_cause.text: The Seagate ST1000DM010-2EP102 hard drive has a hardware or firmware defect that causes random system freezes when Link Power Management (LPM) is enabled.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds "ST1000DM010-2EP102" to the `__ata_dev_quirks` array with `ATA_QUIRK_NOLPM`, which disables LPM for this model. The CVE description states the drive "has problems with LPM, causing random system freezes" and that it belongs to the same family as the previously quirked ST2000DM008-2FR102.
